mapper.select: SELECT id, log_file_name AS logFileName FROM logan_task WHERE add_time < #{cutoff} AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM web_task WHERE add_time < #{cutoff} AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE task, detail FROM logan_task task LEFT JOIN logan_log_detail detail ON detail.task_id = task.id WHERE task.add_time < #{cutoff} AND task.id IN #{id}
DELETE task, detail FROM web_task task LEFT JOIN web_detail detail ON detail.task_id = task.id WHERE task.add_time < #{cutoff} AND task.id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_task WHERE log_file_name = #{fileName} AND add_time >= #{cutoff}
